manifest.description: Inline schema-versioned contract manifest. Families include operationGuards, externalApiCosts, valueDomains, and exact operationShapes for multi-input/result/control/uniqueness policy. Supply exactly one of manifest or manifestPath.

manifestPath.description: Path to a contract-manifest JSON file inside the analyzed workspace. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root. Supply exactly one of manifest or manifestPath.

profileScope.description: Optional committed define profile. The primary profile reuses its retained compilation; another profile executes ephemerally after exact input verification.

moduleScope.description: Optional module/asmdef scope. Especially useful for bounded non-primary-profile execution.

filePaths.description: Optional source-file allowlist for the fact stream.

containingSymbolIds.description: Optional containing-symbol allowlist for occurrence evaluation.

includeRuleIds.description: Optional rule-family or exact contract-id allowlist. Unknown selectors fail loudly.

maxFacts.description: Maximum emitted operation facts. Default 50000; hard cap 250000.

maxFindings.description: Maximum returned findings. Default 200; hard cap 1000. summarize:true further clamps to 25.

maxEvidencePerFinding.description: Maximum evidence records per returned finding. Default 8; hard cap 32. summarize:true omits evidence.

summarize.description: Summary-first default true: retain at most 25 findings and omit their evidence arrays while preserving complete counts and breakdowns. Pass false for bounded evidence detail.

snapshotId.description: Optional exact-publication selection. When present, the tool leases this retained current or graph-only historical snapshot instead of silently reading latest. Historical selections do not retain Roslyn services, so compilation-required tools return their normal unavailable-state result.

expectedSnapshotId.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this exact `snap_<32 lowercase hex>` identity; mismatch returns a structured retryable result without silently reading latest.

expectedAnalysisGeneration.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this process-local generation; mismatch returns expected/actual identity and retry guidance.
